projects.title: Systemic Risk in the Cryptocurrency Ecosystem
projects.context: Financial Risk & Management | Prof. Ashwini Kumar
bullets: Engineered a multi-stage econometric framework combining AR-GARCH(1,1), Transfer Entropy spillover networks, and leave-one-out systemic indices across 8 digital assets over 10 years (stationary ADF: -22.15, p < 0.001).

Discovered stablecoins USDT (SI: 0.1316) and USDC (SI: 0.1222) transmit greater systemic contagion than BTC (0.0754) and ETH (0.0623), with the dominant spillover channel running USDC → USDT (TE: 0.0333).
Applied quantile regression (τ = 0.1, 0.5, 0.9) capturing regulatory shock asymmetry, and modeled tail risk showing USDT kurtosis of 45.10 vs BTC at 12.45.
